[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested breakfast ideas include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Sweet Potato Waffles: Mash cooked sweet potatoes with flour, eggs, and spices, then cook in a waffle iron.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Sweet Potato Hash Browns: Shred sweet potatoes and pan-fry with onions and bell peppers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Sweet Potato Breakfast Bowl: Bake or boil diced sweet potatoes, then top with Greek yogurt, granola, and fresh fruit.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested lunch and dinner ideas include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Roasted Sweet Potato Soup: Roast sweet potatoes with onions and garlic, then blend with chicken or vegetable broth and cream.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Sweet Potato Gnocchi: Boil or pan-fry gnocchi made with cooked, mashed sweet potatoes, flour, and eggs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Sweet Potato Tacos: Bake or roast diced sweet potatoes, then fill tacos with them and toppings like salsa, avocado, and sour cream.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Sweet Potato Gratin: Thinly slice sweet potatoes and layer them in a baking dish with cream, cheese, and spices.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Sweet Potato Curry: Boil or steam diced sweet potatoes, then simmer in a curry sauce made with coconut milk, spices, and protein.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested snacks and sides include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Sweet Potato Fries: Slice sweet potatoes into strips, toss with oil and seasonings, and bake.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Sweet Potato Hummus: Blend cooked sweet potatoes with chickpeas, tahini, garlic, and lemon juice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Roasted Sweet Potato Wedges: Cut sweet potatoes into wedges, toss with oil and seasonings, and roast.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested desserts include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Sweet Potato Pie: Blend boiled or baked sweet potatoes with sugar, eggs, and spices for a pie filling.
